The English mathematician Brian Griffiths died in Southampton, England, on 4 June 2008, according to a [Guardian obituary reprinted on almerja.com](https://almerja.com/more.php?idm=96585). A [University of Nottingham mailing-list notice](https://lists.nottingham.ac.uk/pipermail/maths-education/2008-June/001368.html) confirms the death that year and his link to the University of Southampton. I'm relying on search snippets for both sources and did not open the full pages.

CONFIDENCE: 80
